cohort: 120 pregnant women at term, categorized into two groups: low amniotic fluid index (AFI ≤5 cm) and normal AFI (>5 cm).
finding: While there was no significant difference in NST results and mode of delivery between groups, neonates born to mothers with low AFI had a significantly higher rate of complications, such as low Apgar scores, NICU admission, low birth weight, and meconium aspiration.
